caption: A block that does not exist shows its alias, or the link text, in the unresolved link style.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length<3;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length; if (n<3) throw new Error('inline spans: '+n); const m=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .ibe-inline.is-unresolved'); if (!m || m.textContent!=='the old claim') throw new Error('no unresolved alias'); m.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); return m.textContent; })()

eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['inline-block-embeds']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('inline-block-embeds-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings.drawAll=true; p.settings.style='background'; p.redrawAll(); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length<4;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length; if (n<4) throw new Error('inline spans: '+n); for (let i=0;i<40 && !document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-content > .ibe-line');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-content > .ibe-line')) throw new Error('no line embed'); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['inline-block-embeds']; p.settings.drawAll=false; p.settings.style='underline'; p.pro.signOut(); p.redrawAll(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Rest the pointer on the inline text to see the source block in the page preview.
eval: (async () => { const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}}); l.view.editor.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); for (let i=0;i<40 && document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length<3;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline').length; if (n<3) throw new Error('inline spans: '+n); const el=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline'); const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+20,clientY:r.top+6})); for (let i=0;i<30 && !document.querySelector('.hover-popover');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.hover-popover')) throw new Error('no page preview'); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const el=document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .cm-line .ibe-inline'); for (const t of [el, ...document.querySelectorAll('.hover-popover')]) { if (!t) continue; t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseout',{bubbles:true,relatedTarget:document.body})); t.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseleave',{bubbles:false,relatedTarget:document.body})); } for (let i=0;i<30 && document.querySelector('.hover-popover');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); document.querySelectorAll('.hover-popover').forEach(p => p.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
